_comment: Gold-standard drug-repurposing successes (drug -> NEW indication distinct from original). Used ONLY by the evaluator, and held out from the agents. Each pair has a mechanistic target overlap with the disease's associated targets, so a correct system should re-discover the drug from disease targets alone. All examples are textbook-documented public knowledge.

pairs.reference: PDE5 inhibitor repurposed from erectile dysfunction to PAH (Revatio).
Cereblon-binding immunomodulator repurposed from sedative to multiple myeloma.
Non-selective beta-blocker repurposed from hypertension to infantile hemangioma.
COX-1 inhibitor repurposed from analgesic to antiplatelet cardiovascular prophylaxis.
Antifungal repurposed to inhibit adrenal steroidogenesis in Cushing syndrome.
